question: Would a meat processor (Vissan, Masan MEATLife) or a bakery trial a mung bean protein isolate as an egg-white replacer at USD 5 to 6 per kg, and what gel, foaming and retort specifications would it set?
why_it_matters: Egg-white replacement is the one job where a mung bean isolate made from imported beans could cover its raw-material cost (USD 3.0 to 4.9 per kg of isolate at 2023 to 2025 prices); plant milk priced against Chinese pea protein (USD 2 to 3) cannot
cheapest_way_to_close: Send imported mung bean isolate samples (Chinese or Thai) with a one-page specification to two processors' R&D teams and one industrial bakery; ask for a trial at equal cost to their egg white powder
owner_org_to_ask: Vissan; Masan MEATLife; an industrial bakery; FIRI

question: Does any Vietnamese processor hydrolyse broken rice into syrup, maltose or glucose (for food, beer adjunct or fermentation), and could it separate and sell a rice-protein co-product?
why_it_matters: Rice protein pays only as a co-product: raw material alone costs USD 5.1 to 6.6 per kg of 77% protein product. Without a host the rice arm of T10 has no route; with one, broken rice (USD 327 to 372 per t in 2026) is also a second sugar feedstock for T4 while cassava starch stays near USD 520 to 540 per t
cheapest_way_to_close: Three calls: Vedan (glucose), the Vietnam Food Association (broken-rice uses) and one brewery buying rice adjunct; one search of customs data for rice syrup imports
owner_org_to_ask: Vedan Vietnam; Vietnam Food Association; Sabeco or Heineken Vietnam

question: What protein recovery do industrial wet-process mung bean isolate lines achieve, and at what price would Acecook or other noodle makers buy the mung bean starch co-product in Vietnam?
why_it_matters: The T10 mung bean arm's cost depends on recovery (assumed 60 to 80% here; one snippet suggests product yields of 8 to 19% of bean mass) and on the starch credit, which is the larger part of the bean
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask two isolate-equipment suppliers for a mass balance; ask Acecook's purchasing team for the mung bean starch price and specification

question: Which Vietnamese laboratories hold texture analysers, rheometers and UHT simulators, and would they offer a standard functional panel (solubility, water and oil holding, emulsifying, foaming, gelling) for a fee?
why_it_matters: Decides whether the P4 extension is a scope change at an existing laboratory or new equipment; buyers already specify function but no service was found
cheapest_way_to_close: Email four laboratories (HUST food technology, FIRI NACEFA, Can Tho University Institute of Food and Biotechnology, Nguyen Tat Thanh University's hi-tech centre) with the Embrapa 2022 method list and ask for a price per sample
owner_org_to_ask: HUST; FIRI; Can Tho University; Nguyen Tat Thanh University

question: What are Vietnam's mung bean area, output and farm-gate price in 2024 to 2025, and how do they compare with the 92,000 t in the WorldVeg Delphi study and with imports of 167,108 t in 2025?
why_it_matters: Sets how 'domestic' a mung bean ingredient can be; on the snippet figure, domestic output is about a third to two-fifths of supply (92,000 t against 129,380 to 185,470 t of partner-reported imports in 2023 to 2025; our calculation, Low)
cheapest_way_to_close: NSO statistical yearbook or MAE crop statistics; one call to the Fruit and Vegetable Research Institute
owner_org_to_ask: NSO; MAE; Fruit and Vegetable Research Institute
